rows.name: Rohbau3D
rows.stage: Shell construction, not light wood frame. 504 TLS scans, 14 sites, some residential apartments.
rows.density_labels: FARO Focus M70. Paper: mean about 2.34e7 points per scan, mean surface density 31.7 points/cm^2. xyz, RGB, intensity, normals. 17 foreground classes + background and instances. Class names on a third-party benchmark only.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Best public shell set for walls, beams, columns. No wood-stud class confirmed.

rows.name: BIMNet
rows.stage: Finished interiors from Matterport3D. 25 scans, 382 rooms.
rows.density_labels: >116.5 million points. 14 IFC classes including Beam and Column. Manual IFC models.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Finished structure, not bare studs. Needs Matterport approval.

rows.name: WFC-Dataset
rows.stage: Single 2x4 wood stud, controlled indoor, not a framed house. 288 samples. ZED 2i.
rows.density_labels: Manual 6D pose. 2208x1242 RGB-D. Not wall semantics.
rows.formats: RGB, depth, PLY. Raw zip 10.65 GB.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Best public wood-stud points for a single member OBB.

rows.name: ScanNet++
rows.stage: Finished indoor scenes. Paper 460 scenes; site now 1006. FARO Focus Premium + iPhone 13 Pro.
rows.density_labels: Paper: 0.9 mm average point spacing. >1000 raw semantic labels. Not studs.
rows.formats: Mesh, DSLR, iPhone RGB-D. Default download ~1.5 TB.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Caveat: finished interiors. Sensor comparison and pretraining only.

rows.name: buildingSMART Sample-Test-Files
rows.stage: Design IFC models, including a duplex. No scan.

rows.name: FARO WebShare public demos
rows.stage: Mixed scanned projects, not a frame-house library.
rows.formats: WebShare stream. Raw LAS download not found.

rows.name: Leica RC SDK sample library
rows.stage: Boiler room, indoor office, church square. Not wood frame.
rows.density_labels: Office set has a classification. Class list not read. Tevas ~295 million points.

rows.name: Polycam self-capture
rows.stage: Whatever we scan. No public frame set found.
rows.formats: PLY, LAS, PTS, XYZ, DXF on Business/Enterprise
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Only immediate source of our own framed walls. Not TLS-accurate.

rows.name: IntCDC timber laser scans
rows.stage: Assembled timber buildings after alignment. Not light-frame 2x4.
rows.density_labels: Full clouds. Semantic stud labels not stated. Multi-GB LAS.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Closest public wood building frame (post-assembly). Not light-frame 2x4. Rank 1 in 06-top5-frame-pointclouds.md.

rows.name: RefSite3D
rows.stage: Modular multi-material demonstrator (concrete, timber, steel) on the Reference Construction Site Aachen. Not a residential wood-frame house. PM2 adds timber elements.
rows.density_labels: Point spacing not stated. Scene labels: environment, ground, target. Timber-component benchmark split exists. No stud class.
rows.formats: PLY, OBJ, JSON, TXT. Zip 2.2 GB. CC BY 4.0.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Real timber in an assembly, Open3D-readable PLY. Not a 2x4 house. Rank 3 in the top-5 note.

rows.name: ConSLAM
rows.stage: One floor of the Whiteley's London redevelopment (retail, leisure, and a residential scheme) scanned over about four months. Not wood frame.
rows.density_labels: No semantic stud labels. Ground truth is a survey PLY. Point spacing not stated.
rows.formats: PLY ground truth, ROS bags, RGB, NIR. Code licence is academic use only.
rows.fit_for_stud_qa: Construction-floor TLS for Open3D after download. Not studs. Rank 5 in the top-5 note.
